module_summary: AXI virtual FIFO top: write engine streams segmented input into a DRAM ring buffer, read engine streams it back out, exchanging pointers; a small reset/enable controller latches base/mask config.

anchors.name: input_data
anchors.why: Segmented input data passed to write engine on input_clk.

anchors.name: input_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment input valid to write engine.

anchors.name: input_ready
anchors.why: Per-segment input ready from write engine FIFOs.

anchors.name: output_data
anchors.why: Segmented output data streamed from read engine.

anchors.name: output_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment output valid from read engine.

anchors.name: output_ready
anchors.why: Downstream ready into read engine output FIFOs.

anchors.name: output_ctrl_data
anchors.why: Optional control output data, disabled by CTRL_OUT_EN default.

anchors.name: output_ctrl_valid
anchors.why: Optional control output valid from read engine.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write burst address generated by write engine.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid from write engine.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data stream from write engine to memory.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read burst address generated by read engine.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid from read engine.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data returned to read engine buffers.

anchors.name: wr_finish_ptr
anchors.why: Write-complete pointer from write engine telling read engine available data.

anchors.name: wr_start_ptr
anchors.why: Write issue pointer exported from write engine to read engine.

anchors.name: rd_finish_ptr
anchors.why: Read-complete pointer from read engine freeing space for writes.

anchors.name: rd_start_ptr
anchors.why: Read issue pointer exported from read engine to write engine.

anchors.name: fifo_enable_reg
anchors.why: FIFO active flag enabling both engines; set on cfg_enable, cleared in reset.

anchors.name: fifo_base_addr_reg
anchors.why: Latched ring buffer base address fed to both engines.

anchors.name: fifo_size_mask_reg
anchors.why: Latched ring buffer size mask fed to both engines.

anchors.name: cfg_enable
anchors.why: Software enable request; latches config and sets enable flag.

anchors.name: cfg_reset
anchors.why: Software reset request triggering FIFO flush and reset sync.

anchors.name: cfg_fifo_base_addr
anchors.why: Configured base address input, masked into base register.

anchors.name: rst_sync_3_reg
anchors.why: Final stage of reset request synchronizer asserting FIFO reset.

anchors.name: rst_req_out
anchors.why: OR of all reset sources exported for cross-instance reset sync.

anchors.name: sts_write_active
anchors.why: Write engine busy; holds FIFO reset until flushed.

anchors.name: sts_read_active
anchors.why: Read engine busy; holds FIFO reset until flushed.

anchors.name: sts_fifo_occupancy
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy count reported by write engine.

anchors.name: sts_active
anchors.why: Active status output copying enable register.

anchors.name: input_watermark
anchors.why: Input FIFO watermark indication from write engine.

groups.name: Write engine
groups.description: Write instance moving input segments into DRAM ring via AXI writes.

groups.name: Read engine
groups.description: Read instance fetching ring data via AXI reads and streaming output segments.

groups.name: Reset and enable control
groups.description: Synchronizes reset requests, flushes engines, latches base/mask and enables FIFO.
